reviews.notes: Domain is heavily over-stuffed (~105 roles) with generic ISCO 2149 'engineer, n.e.c.' entries and cross-domain contamination — roughly a third of the list is not civil. remove_roles covers 11 junk NaN group labels, ~11 unrelated engineering disciplines, 6 renewable-energy roles (D019), and 10 non-civil drafters (D017/electronics). overfanout_roles flags generic 2149 catch-all engineers that aren't civil-specific and should be centralised in a general-engineering bucket rather than duplicated here. A cluster of energy-assessment/advisory 3112 roles (domestic energy assessor, energy assessor, energy analyst, energy consultant, energy conservation officer) also lean toward an energy domain and are borderline — left in but worth a second pass. Genuine civil core (civil engineer, construction engineer, geological/geotechnical, drainage, water, transport, pipeline, rail project, airport planning, hydropower, bridge/building/railway inspectors, surveying/road/rail technicians, construction safety & quality) is sound.
